description: Attests that a proposed remediation is closed. G11: remediated MAY be true only when BOTH ownerMerged (a human owner merged the PR/patch) AND akumaReprobePass (akuma re-probed the same finding via its closeFinding path and the exposure is gone). No self-attested closure. R0 = schema skeleton; R1 = additionalProperties=false + required-field enforcement + akuma re-probe CID verification.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of closure attestation.

findingCid.description: CID of the upstream akuma finding being closed.

ownerMerged.description: G11: a human owner merged the PR / applied the patch. Required true for remediated=true.

ownerMergeUri.description: URI/commit of the owner's merge (evidence for ownerMerged).

akumaReprobePass.description: G11: akuma re-probed the same finding (closeFinding re-probe path, ADR-2605151400) and the exposure is gone. Required true for remediated=true.

akumaReprobeFindingCid.description: CID of the akuma re-probe finding record verifying closure.

remediated.description: True iff ownerMerged AND akumaReprobePass. Structural conjunction enforced at the cell layer (G11).
